messages:
Avery: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on security/compliance. I promised a short thread to capture open Qs and leadership answers so product and sales have a clear ask list. Drop anything operational or roadmap-related here and we'll turn it into action items.
Maya: Quick one — can you confirm SOC2/ISO targets? Some customers asked whether Private (on-prem/VPC) will be in scope for the same attestation.
Sam: Short answer: roadmap split. We’re targeting SOC2 Type 2 for Hosted + Dedicated by end of Q4 this year; ISO27001 assessment will follow (early next year). Private/on-prem packages will have contractual controls and evidence bundles but separate attestations only if customers engage the enterprise compliance pathway.
Maya: Got it. For the evidence bundles — will the Console expose an evidence portal or is that manual?
Sam: We plan an "evidence playbook" in Console: downloadable artifacts (config snapshots, deployment manifests, audit exports) and a checklist that maps to controls. MVP will include automated export of audit logs + role mappings. ETA: early Q4.
Julien: On the networking side — customers asked about PrivateLink vs customer VPC peering. Which are we shipping first? Any caveats for cross-region log export?
Sam: PrivateLink is higher priority (lower customer-side network work) — we expect a PrivateLink beta mid-Q3. Peering and direct VPC attachment remain options for Dedicated. Cross-region log export is supported but encrypted in transit and will respect region residency settings; we'll add a guidance doc with recommended S3 bucket setups and VPC endpoints.
Maya: Audit logs retention question: default vs configurable? Some finance teams need 24 months of tamper-evident logs.
Sam: Default retention: 12 months in the Console. We're adding configurable retention up to 36 months for Enterprise plans. We also support export to customer-managed S3 and BigQuery for long-term storage and tamper-evident workflows (signing). For now you can pull daily compressed JSONL via the export API. Example export path we suggest: `s3://<org>-redwood-audit/2025/05/events-<day>.jsonl`.
Priya: On KMS/BYOK — customers asked if they can rotate keys without downtime and how we prove key provenance for audits.
Sam: BYOK roadmap: pilot Q3, GA Q1 next year. Designs allow customer-side rotation with on-the-fly rewrap to avoid app downtime; we’ll document rotation playbooks. For provenance we’ll include signed key metadata and HSM-backed attestation artifacts. HSM integrations will initially be partner-backed (cloud HSM) and later offer more direct options.
Maya: Any interim mitigations sales can offer until BYOK GA?
Sam: Yes: dedicated instances with our key separation (non-shared key material) + customer-controlled export for backups. We’ll provide a binding statement for contracts in the meantime.
Avery: On SLAs — leaders asked whether compliance milestones affect SLA promises for Dedicated customers (e.g., latency/availability guarantees if a customer insists on extreme controls).
Julien: From infra POV, most controls (VPC, dedicated GPU pools) don't change SLOs. But some heavy tamper-evident pipelines (continuous immutable backups with cross-region replication) add operational overhead.
Avery: So we should manage expectations in sales — any controls that materially change the cost/sla should be surfaced as options with clear tradeoffs.
Maya: Good call — I'll add a one-page customer-facing matrix (controls vs impact) to the sales kit.
Sam: Follow-ups I'm actioning: 1) Compliance playbook outline (Console artifacts + API paths) — deliver by 2 weeks. 2) BYOK pilot plan (scope, partners, attestation) — draft by end of month. 3) PrivateLink beta timeline — confirm dates with infra this week.
Julien: I'll own PrivateLink timeline and the cross-region log guidance doc.
Priya: I'll draft a short legal note for sales about interim contractual language re: attestations and evidence delivery.
Maya: For the evidence portal, can we include an export that maps evidence to SOC2 control IDs? That'll make audits far easier for enterprise buyers.
Sam: Agreed — we’ll map artifacts to Trust Services Criteria and include a CSV manifest in exports.
ops-bot: deploy: compliance-evidence-playbook v0.1 deployed to staging :rocket: (build #8242)
Avery: Nice — thanks. Last ask: if anyone on the thread has specific customer asks (customer name and exact ask), DM Maya so she can prioritize. I'll follow up in one week with an action tracker. :eyes:
